'''Centa Sonhan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sympathizer who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during the war, Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Ingah Muloha]] contacted him, asking him to help capture the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]]. He agreed and Nadon was captured and held aboard [[Centa Sonhan's sail barge|Sonhan's sail barge]]. Sonhan died shortly after when his barge was [[Attack on Centa Sonhan's sail barge|attacked]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team that had been tasked with freeing Nadon.
